request.text: Check whether it will rain at Central Market this afternoon, and if it will, remind me when I arrive there to buy batteries.

responsibilities.outcome: Determine whether rain is expected at Central Market this afternoon.
If rain is expected, create a reminder that triggers when the user arrives at Central Market to buy batteries.

semantic_facts: The requested reminder is conditional on the weather result and uses an arrival trigger that the available time-based reminder Capability cannot represent.
The planner should explain the trigger limitation and ask whether the user wants to substitute a specific date and time, without running the otherwise ready weather lookup as a partial result.
forbidden_claims: The assistant invents an arrival time, silently changes the reminder to a clock-based trigger, or claims to have created it.
The planner emits or executes the weather lookup while the dependent reminder responsibility remains unresolved.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: An unsupported event trigger is silently rewritten as a fabricated time-based reminder.
A ready sibling task leaks into execution even though the conditional multi-responsibility result is incomplete.
